name: Skilled Crews
summary: Friendly Aeldari Vehicle units' ranged weapons gain the Assault ability.

name: Path of the Warrior
summary: When an Aspect Warriors or Avatar of Khaine unit is selected to shoot or fight, choose for that phase: re-roll Hit rolls of 1, or re-roll Wound rolls of 1, for that unit's attacks.

name: Relentless Raiders
summary: While you control an objective, an enemy unit ending a move within range takes D3 mortal wounds on a 2+. An Anhrathe unit in range keeps you in control until the opponent's control level there exceeds yours.

name: Veterans of the Void
summary: Each Anhrathe unit added to your army can take one unique Corsair Enhancement, paying its points cost; you cannot include a unit whose Enhancement would push your army over the points limit.

name: Strength from Death
summary: Include Ynnari despite the missing Asuryani keyword; non-Epic-Hero Asuryani gain Ynnari; Yvraine and/or The Yncarne must be taken, one as Warlord. Ynnari get a D6+1" move after a shooting loss or a Fade Back, and Fights First when depleted.

name: Veterans of the Void
summary: Each Anhrathe unit added to your army can take one unique Corsair Enhancement, paying its points cost; you cannot include a unit whose Enhancement would push your army over the points limit.

name: Yriel’s Own
summary: Aeldari units can declare a charge in a turn they advanced. Anhrathe, Rangers and Shroud Runners units can re-roll their Advance roll.

name: Acrobatic Onslaught
summary: A charging Harlequins unit can move through enemy models. This detachment carries the Acrobatic tag and cannot be combined with another Acrobatic detachment.

name: Acrobatic Onslaught
summary: A charging Harlequins model can move through enemy models. Travelling Players Troupe units gain Battleline and Objective Control 2; field up to three each of Death Jester, Shadowseer and Troupe Master.

name: Defend at All Costs
summary: Dire Avenger, Guardian, Support Weapon, and War Walker attacks get +1 to hit when the attacker or its target is within range of an objective marker.

name: Far-Reaching Doom
summary: While a Rangers or Shroud Runners unit is shooting, enemy detection range against it is increased by 6" until it finishes shooting.

name: Strands of Fate
summary: Roll a Fate dice pool at the start of the battle: 3 D6 at Incursion, 6 at Strike Force, 9 at Onslaught. Discard a die showing a listed Stratagem's value to cut that use of it by 1CP.

name: Boons of the Brood
summary: Harlequins Mounted/Vehicle weapons get Sustained Hits 1; a disembarking Harlequins unit's weapons gain it that turn. Travelling Players Troupe gain Battleline and OC 2; field up to three each of Death Jester, Shadowseer and Troupe Master.

name: Shepherds of the Dead
summary: Destroying an Asuryani Psyker gives the killer a Vengeful Dead token; Wraith Construct attacks on it get +1 to hit/wound. Asuryani Psykers give Wraithblades/Wraithguard/Wraithlord within 12" Battle Focus; the first two also gain Battleline.

name: Dance of Distortion
summary: Friendly Harlequins units gain Stealth. This detachment carries the exclusive Acrobatic tag.

name: Martial Grace
summary: Each battle round you get one extra Battle Focus token. The Swift as the Wind Agile Manoeuvre grants an extra 1" Move, and any Agile Manoeuvre D6 roll gets +1.

name: Ride the Wind
summary: Asuryani Mounted and Vyper units may start in Reserves and arrive as if the battle round were one higher. At the end of your opponent's turn you can return 1/2/3 of them (by battle size) to Strategic Reserves. Windriders gain Battleline.
